titolo: Fonti su GitHub Actions per ADR-0003: skipped conta come superato, needs salta i job a valle, workflow letto dal commit dell'evento, concurrency annulla le esecuzioni in attesa; nome del check = nome del job resta un'ipotesi
contesto: Il lotto chiede fonte con frase citata, oppure ipotesi con comando, per ogni affermazione su Actions che regge D1-D8. Citazioni prese dal sorgente di github/docs scaricato con curl e cercato con grep.
evidenza: troubleshooting-required-status-checks.md: «Successful check statuses are `success`, `skipped`, and `neutral`.»; riga di tabella «A job depends on a failed job | The dependent job is skipped and may not block merging | Use `always()` with `needs` for required checks that depend on other jobs.»

data/reusables/actions/workflows/skipped-job-status-checks-passing.md: «A job that is skipped will report its status as "Success". It will not prevent a pull request from merging, even if it is a required check.»

data/reusables/actions/jobs/section-using-jobs-in-a-workflow-needs.md: «If a job fails or is skipped, all jobs that need it are skipped unless the jobs use a conditional expression that causes the job to continue.»

data/reusables/actions/about-triggers.md (incluso in content/actions/concepts/workflows-and-actions/workflows.md): «Each workflow run will use the version of the workflow that is present in the associated commit SHA or Git ref of the event.»

events-that-trigger-workflows.md, pull_request: «Note that `GITHUB_SHA` for this event is the last merge commit of the pull request merge branch.»; «Workflows will not run on `pull_request` activity if the pull request has a merge conflict.»
data/reusables/actions/actions-group-concurrency.md: «By default, any existing `pending` job or workflow in the same concurrency group will be canceled»

about-protected-branches.md: «make sure that job names are unique across all workflows»; section-using-jobs-in-a-workflow-name.md dice solo «displayed in the GitHub UI»: nessuna frase dice che il nome del check run è il name del job -> H1
nessuna fonte trovata per il suffisso di matrice (H2) né per lo SHA su cui sta il check run di pull_request (H3)
$ curl raw withastro/astro/main/packages/telemetry/src/index.ts; grep -n TELEMETRY_DISABLED -> riga 95 if (Boolean(this.ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED || this.TELEMETRY_DISABLED))
esito: 15 fonti citate (F1-F13 con varianti) e 8 ipotesi (H1-H8) con comando nell'ADR
